name: How does AKN Design Group manage dust and fumes during interior painting for renovation projects?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group manage dust and fumes during interior painting for renovation projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: During interior painting for renovation projects, AKN Design Group prioritizes maintaining a clean and safe environment, managing dust and fumes effectively. Our process includes isolating work areas with plastic sheeting and drop cloths to contain dust and protect adjacent spaces. We also ensure proper ventilation by using fans and opening windows where feasible, to minimize the buildup of paint fumes. While some odor is inevitable, modern low-VOC paints also contribute to a better indoor air quality experience. This careful site management reflects our commitment to a high-touch homeowner experience and minimizes disruption during your substantial renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group manages dust and fumes during interior painting by isolating work areas, using proper ventilation, and utilizing low-VOC paints. This ensures a cleaner, safer environment during your renovation.
